title: Chat Application
description: A real-time messaging application that enables users to communicate instantly through an intuitive and responsive chat interface. The project focuses on seamless user interaction, modern UI design, and efficient message handling.

title: Gym Management System
description: A comprehensive gym management platform designed to manage memberships, attendance records, workout plans, and member information efficiently through a user-friendly dashboard.

title: AI-Powered Utility Bill Analyzer
description: An AI-based application that analyzes utility bills, extracts key information, identifies usage patterns, and generates meaningful insights to help users better understand and manage their expenses.

title: Student Attendance Tracker
description: A web-based attendance management system that allows institutions to record, monitor, and manage student attendance efficiently while providing easy access to attendance reports.

title: Todo List App
description: A simple and interactive task management application that enables users to add, edit, delete, and organize daily tasks efficiently with a clean and responsive interface.

title: Netflix Clone
description: A responsive Netflix-inspired streaming platform clone featuring an engaging user interface, movie listings, banners, and modern design principles to recreate the Netflix browsing experience.
